title: Radial fall of an A-B pair from r0 = 9: is the A-B force the A-A force times one constant?
pitch: Same geometry as the A-A fall that won last night (2026-11-24/r3/001-002): A and B at rest, 9 apart, horizontal, T = 10. The A-A fall matches the P-0027 table at noise level before contact. The test: K_AB(r) / K_AA(r) is constant over separation 9 to contact, as a shared q_A q_B factorisation requires. A ratio that moves with r refutes factorisation. Pre-contact part only is fitted; the A-A fall gives the reference profile in the same geometry.
